title: docs(skills): objectstack-ui teaches the action preflight read

_Requested by **Irene** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TJXtQ1tVD26ecLDZxFS67x?thread=cmsg_01TJXtQ1tVD26ecLDZxFS67x4oQjpv1RC4RK8r5ut1onSW)_

Fixes #31860

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

`dispatch-gates --tier` reads a contract-review model mandate for `skills/**` (clause ①). That mandate is waived by the maintainer's standing order in this project (2026-11-03). This card ran on the project's default model, and the dispatching seat (domain:skills#3) runs the contract review.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`skills/objectstack-ui/rules/actions.md` 在 `submitText` 旁加一条 `preflight` 说明:参数对话框提交前发一次同源 `GET`,把结果画在参数上方,并可用 `seed` 回填只读参数。
- 教的内容全部按 `main` 上的 schema(`action.zod.ts`)和控制台读取器(`ActionParamDialog.tsx`)核对过,卡里的说法在 `main` 上都成立,没有差异。
- 评测 `views-apps-actions-pages.json` 新增用例 16(升级前读计划、用 `seed` 回填令牌)。
- 字节:同文件删两处标题里的复述(79 字节)先付,余下按「A:先削重复,余额按实测提高」把 actions.md 的 token 天花板 2259 → 2453。
- 后续:`content/docs/protocol/objectui/actions.mdx` 仍写着 preflight 是 "Planned",另卡 follow-up: #32080,不在本 PR。
- 需要你做的:`check-governed-merges` 判为 **Tier H**(`skills/**`),需 `os-zhuang` 或 `hotlong` 批准;当前 head 尚无席位契约复核 PASS,契约复核待做,请先不要批。

## The changed lines

`skills/objectstack-ui/rules/actions.md`, one bullet after `submitText`:

```diff
 - `submitText` — the verb on the param dialog's submit button ("Send", "Log Call") in place of "Confirm": an I18nLabel, refused blank and refused without a non-empty `params` (no dialog opens); `submitLabel` / `confirmLabel` are refused naming this key.
+- `preflight` — a read the param dialog shows above the params before submit: `{ read: { url }, path?, fields?, seed? }` sends one `GET` (no other `method`, no body or credentials) to a same-origin API path (one leading `/`) whose only holes are `${param.NAME}` (a declared param; re-read when it changes), `${ctx.recordId}` and `${ctx.record.FIELD}`. `path` selects the answer's sub-tree (`data`); `fields` rows are `resultDialog.fields`' `{ path, label?, format? }` (omitted: JSON). Each `seed: [{ param, path }]` entry fills a declared param, drawn read-only and submitted as shown: seeded once, no `defaultValue` / `defaultFromRow` / `carryOver`, read by no hole; mark it `required` so Confirm waits for the answer. Refused without a non-empty `params` and beside `execution: 'aggregate'`. UX, not authorization: the endpoint still checks a seeded value.
```

The two cuts that pay for it, in the same file:

```diff
-## Opening in a New Tab (`openIn` / `opensInNewTab` / `newTabUrl`)
+## Opening in a New Tab
 
-### `openIn: 'new-tab'` — simplest case (static `target`)
+### `openIn: 'new-tab'`
```

- The H2's key list is what the two H3s right below it are titled (`openIn: 'new-tab'`, and `opensInNewTab` + `newTabUrl`).
- The H3's tail "simplest case (static `target`)" is what the paragraph's first sentence says: "A **static** `target` URL on a `type: 'url'` action".
- No link, script or test pins either heading (`grep -rn "actions.md#"` over `skills/`, `content/`, `packages/`, `scripts/` finds nothing).

No example was added: the file's `os:check` block (`ReassignLeadAction`) shows a reassign, which has nothing to read first. A preflight there would be invented for the key, and each byte is ratcheted.

## Each taught claim and its source on `main` (`ff04ad811`)

Every claim was also checked with a `tsx` probe that parses actions through `ActionSchema` from `packages/spec/src/ui/action.zod.ts`: the eval's action parses, and each refusal below fires with the message named.

| Claim in the bullet | Schema (`packages/spec/src/ui/action.zod.ts`) | Console reader |
|:--|:--|:--|
| Shape `{ read: { url }, path?, fields?, seed? }` | L1798 `preflight: strictObject(...)`, `read` L1821, `path` L1845, `fields` L1849, `seed` L1853 | `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/actionDialogCompanion.ts` L85 `judgeActionPreflight` re-judges the stored block with `ActionSchema` before anything is sent |
| One `GET`, no other `method` | L1840 `method: z.literal('GET', …)` | `ActionParamDialog.tsx` L792 `readElementApi(url, doFetch)` |
| No body or credentials | `read` guidance L1826-L1834 (`headers`, `credentials`, `auth`, `authorization`, `token`, `apiKey` → `API_READ_NO_CREDENTIALS`; `body` refused), and the same credential keys on the block, L1813-L1818 | reads with the host's signed-in fetch (`apiFetch`), `ActionParamDialog.tsx` L784 |
| Same-origin API path, one leading `/` | L1838 `.regex(SAME_ORIGIN_API_PATH_RE, …)`; the rule is `packages/spec/src/ui/same-origin-api-read.ts` L67 | `ActionParamDialog.tsx` L783 re-checks the filled URL with `isSameOriginApiTarget` |
| Holes only `${param.NAME}` (declared), `${ctx.recordId}`, `${ctx.record.FIELD}` | L2435 `preflightHoleParam` (the closed set), refused at L2518-L2532; an undeclared param at L2535-L2543 | `ui/packages/core/src/actions/ActionRunner.ts` L2122 `preflightReadFiller` fills them; a hole with no value sends nothing |
| Re-read when a hole's param changes | — | `ActionParamDialog.tsx` header L77-L78; L775 `waitingOn`, the read effect keyed on the filled URL (L825) |
| `path` selects the answer's sub-tree | L1845-L1848 | `ActionParamDialog.tsx` L798 `selectElementApiPath(body, path)` |
| `fields` rows are `resultDialog.fields`' `{ path, label?, format? }`; omitted, JSON | L844-L858 `actionAnswerFieldRow`, shared by `resultDialog.fields` (L1735) and `preflight.fields` (L1849) | `PreflightPanel`, `ActionParamDialog.tsx` L471-L485 (each row through the result dialog's renderer; no `fields` → the answer as JSON) |
| `seed` fills a declared param, read-only, submitted as shown | L1853-L1862 | L770 (seeded param carried as `carryOver`, submitted verbatim), L1014-L1025 (drawn read-only) |
| Seeded once | L2570 | — |
| No `defaultValue` / `defaultFromRow` / `carryOver` | L2582-L2594 | — |
| Read by no hole | L2597-L2605 | — |
| `required` holds Confirm until the answer | docblock L1784 | header L88-L90: a refused or failed read leaves the seed empty, so `required` holds Confirm |
| Refused without a non-empty `params` | L2484-L2491 | — |
| Refused beside `execution: 'aggregate'` | L2493-L2502 | — |
| UX, not authorization | docblock L1795-L1796 | header L90-L91 |

**Card claims against `main`:** all hold. The card's "credentials, a body or extra keys are refused" is the strict object plus the guidance rows above; nothing in the card is false on `main`.

## Sweep

`skills/objectstack-ui/**` (SKILL.md, every `rules/*.md`, `evals/*.json`) and the other published skills were read for any sentence `preflight` makes false.

- **No hit in `skills/objectstack-ui/**`.** No skill teaches a hand-rolled read-before-submit companion. SKILL.md L132's pointer ("`locations`, visibility, examples, `ctx`, new tab, params") stays true.
- Near miss, left as it is (seat ruling): the new-tab callout in `actions.md` says `params` is "`ActionParam[]` for **user input** only". A seeded param is not typed, but carry-over params already were not; the callout's point (never encode behaviour as a param) still holds.
- Outside this PR:
  - `skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md` L164 lists `resultDialog.fields.{path}` bundle keys but not `preflight.fields.{path}`. That is card #31925, already filed.
  - `content/docs/protocol/objectui/actions.mdx` L235 and L568 still say `preflight` is planned and not drawn by the console. `packages/spec/liveness/action.json` L285 records it LIVE. Follow-up: #32080.
  - `content/docs/references/ui/action.mdx` L57 and L172 (generated) already match the schema.

## The eval case

`skills/objectstack-ui/evals/views-apps-actions-pages.json` gains case 16, in case 11's shape (a param dialog key, `must_contain` / `must_not_contain`):

- Prompt: an Upgrade action that asks for a version, shows what the upgrade will change before confirm, and posts the plan's token.
- Expected: `preflight: { read: { url: '/api/v1/packages/${ctx.recordId}/upgrade-plan?version=${param.version}' }, path: 'data', fields: [...], seed: [{ param: 'plan_token', path: 'token' }] }` beside required `version` and `plan_token` params; no hand-rolled fetch, no absolute URL, credential headers or non-GET read, no `result` hole.
- Every `must_contain` string is in `expected_output` literally, and no `must_not_contain` string (`headers:`, `${result.`) is. The action in it parses through `ActionSchema` (probe above).

## Token ratchet

| File | Before | After | Ceiling |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/actions.md` | 9028 B, 2257 tokens | 9810 B, 2453 tokens | 2259 → 2453 (headroom 0) |

The bullet is 861 bytes with its newline. The two cuts pay 79 bytes and the row's 8 bytes of headroom absorb 8; the ceiling moves by the remaining 194 tokens, pinned at the measurement. The seat widened the surface to this one row (`scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`) under the standing ruling 「A:先削重复,余额按实测提高」, quoted verbatim in the row's comment as the two earlier raises of this row are. The eval case is measured, not ratcheted.

## Changeset

`.changeset/skills-ui-action-preflight.md`: `'@objectstack/skills': patch`, with `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` (the key already exists; this only teaches it).

## Gates

All 62 ran on head `4c8e54b3` after `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts` and a full `pnpm build` (exit 0), under `NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=8192`: **62 × exit 0, 0 NOT MEASURED** among the listed commands. The CI-only families dispatch-gates names as not locally measurable (shard attestation, Build Core steps, type-check lanes, dogfood jobs) are left to CI.
